questions.questionText:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming
the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts,
decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

All equipment are screw-drivers.
All machines are equipment.
Conclusions:
I. Some screw-drivers are equipment. 
II. Some screw-drivers are machines. 
III. All equipment are machines.
options: Only conclusions I and III follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (D).
The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (A).
